$comment: Lead receives the full Paseo MCP catalog. The URL is agent-scoped and supplied at runtime by pi-role-app-server via the PASEO_MCP_URL env var (derived from PASEO_AGENT_ID). Missing PASEO_MCP_URL fails closed at connect time — the server does not impersonate another agent. Add "bearerTokenEnv": "PASEO_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN" only if the local daemon enforces bearer auth.
